profile.headline: Lead Software Developer at athenahealth
profile.summary:
Laurico da Cruz Neves, Master degree in Computer Science from Bridgewater State University.
I am a highly skilled and professional Software|Web developer having more than two years in web development. I have a very good knowledge of ASP.NET. Fluent in C#, Microsoft Technologies ASP.NET Web forms, ASP.NET MVC, SQL Server, HTML, JavaScript, JQuery, AJAX, CSS.

positions.title: Associate Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop new components using Asp.net Web form and make them available in Sitecore. Responsible for integrating some front-end elements into the application.
•	Lead the release process, where we deploy the application to the different environments at the end of each sprint. I had the opportunity to execute important techniques during this critical process such as deploy the website using TeamCity, taking the built artifacts, distributing them to all machines and environments using Octopus and manage package through Sitecore.
•	Work on Salesforce and Eloqua API integration in ah.com application to engage clients and allow the company to get leads.
•	Migrate the ah.com application from HTTP to HTTPS to secure the communication between the user and ah.com.
•	Create new dynamic components and cards layout from provided design concepts by using standard HTML / CSS / JavaScript (AJAX, Jquery) practices.
•	Research & prototype new technologies (HTML5, CSS3) and provide recommendations for application improvement as it pertains to the user interface.
•	Collaborate with, Creative and Product Management teams to design and develop the website user experience.

positions.title: Information Technology Systems
positions.description:
Ensuring that backup systems operate effectively.
Performing daily server checking.
Manage user accounts in Active Directory with Windows PowerShell.
Manage Linux User Accounts (Red Hat).
Used SCCM to ensure proper functionality of computer systems.
Ensure the SQL databases were working correctly.

Windows Server, Exchange 2007, Powershell, Red Hat, SQL Server

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Maintained and developed new features to improve the accounting website using PHP, JasperReport, JavaScript, Jquery, CSS, HTML and PostgreSQL. I implemented a Student Bill Payment project that allows employees to process payments and check student status. I maintained and developed a website that allows employees to fill in student related information and more. I helped to migrate data from one PostgreSQL database to another using DBLink.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Worked extensively with Microsoft Technologies ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, C#, SQL, Razor, CSS, HTML, JASON, AJAX, Twitter Bootstrap technology and Team Foundation Server. I implemented the contact and product pages, allowing clients to choose services based on their requirements, I created email templates from scratch and I helped to develop the product checkout process.

positions.title: Web Developer and Help Desk
positions.description:
Maintained and developed the Digital Repository of University of Cape Verde using PHP, CSS, JavaScript and HTML. The repository allows the academic community to publish all researches and theses completed at the University of Cape Verde. I helped to solve problems on the Network.
As Help Desk I helped the IT-System to create and manage the Domain DECM.CV using Active Directory. I helped to solve problems on the Network such as Setup Switch and Router and Setup Computers with Windows.

projects.title: Integrated Information System of UniCV
projects.description:
Develop and Implement a business model for SIIUNICV.
Infrastructure Design of the SIIUNICV

projects.title: SIIUnicv
projects.description: Update the system and Create and implement new functionalities. Give support to the users.
